_comment: PurpleLab MCP Client Configurations — copy the section for your tool
_note: Replace YOUR_KEY with your PURPLELAB_MCP_API_KEY from .env (run `grep PURPLELAB_MCP_API_KEY .env`)
_discovery: GET http://localhost:8002/api/v2/mcp  — returns live key + all connection instructions

claude_code_cli._comment: Claude Code CLI — run once in any terminal
claude_code_cli.command: claude mcp add purplelab --transport http --url http://localhost:8002/api/v2/mcp --header 'X-API-Key:YOUR_KEY'

claude_desktop._comment: Claude Desktop — add to ~/Library/Application Support/Claude/claude_desktop_config.json (macOS) or %APPDATA%\Claude\claude_desktop_config.json (Windows)

claude_desktop_sse._comment: Claude Desktop via SSE transport (alternative — use if http transport is not supported by your client version)

vscode._comment: VS Code MCP extension — add to .vscode/mcp.json in your workspace, or User settings.json under 'mcp.servers'

joti._comment: Joti MCP Hub registration — use scripts/register_with_joti.py OR manually POST to Joti /api/mcp-hub/servers

docker_internal._comment: When your MCP client runs inside Docker on the same host (e.g. Joti containers)
docker_internal.note: Add purplelab network to your client's docker-compose.yml: networks: [purplelab]
